Subject: Update on Your Application for the Marketing Position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the marketing position at our company. We appreciate the effort you put into your application and the opportunity to learn more about your background.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose profiles more closely align with our current needs. Please know that this decision was not a reflection of your skills or qualifications, as we were impressed by your experience. However, we are looking for a specific fit for this particular role.

We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers page for future openings that may be a better match for your expertise. We wish you the very best in your job search and professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Company Name]
